interventions.detail: System Python 3.12 is unsupported (docs say <=3.10); created a Python 3.10 venv with uv
paddlepaddle==2.3.2 is no longer on PyPI or the tuna mirror; installed paddlepaddle==2.6.2 CPU instead
Installed libgl1 and libglib2.0-0t64 because opencv-python needs libGL.so.1
Pinned setuptools<80 because newer setuptools dropped the pkg_resources module that ppdet/model_zoo imports
ppdet/data/source/dataset.py ImageFolder._load_images loaded the COCO val annotation file unconditionally; now it loads only when do_eval
ppdet/utils/visualizer.py cached simfang.ttf under a literal ./~ dir; added os.path.expanduser and pre-downloaded the font
Used 'uv pip install -e .' instead of the deprecated 'python setup.py install'
